chunks.label: reality
chunks.html:
Chapter 01 · The Reality

You have probably been told this is complicated. That it will take years, cost a fortune, or simply cannot be done.

Usually that is not a verdict on your mouth. It is a verdict on the tools available to whoever was looking at it.

Most implant failures are not surgical failures. They are planning failures — and planning is the entire discipline a prosthodontist trains three extra years to do.

Most implant cases pass through three or four sets of hands. Here, they don’t.

Dr. Nahlah vs A General Practice
Board-certified prosthodontist — three years of specialist training beyond dental school. A weekend implant course, or a referral out.
Surgery and final teeth planned and placed by the same specialist. Handed between a surgeon, a dentist and an outside lab.
The final smile is designed first — implants are placed to serve it. Implants placed first, restoration figured out afterwards.
Complex and failed cases accepted — including work other practices decline. Straightforward cases only.
IV sedation certified, with hospital privileges at Inova Fairfax. Local anaesthetic, or a referral for sedation.

chunks.html:
Dr. Esam NahlahD.D.S., M.S.
Chapter 03 · The Specialist

The credentials behind the work.

Dr. Nahlah has practised dentistry since 2003, moving to Northern Virginia in 2013 to focus entirely on prosthodontics — esthetic dentistry, implant dentistry, full-mouth rehabilitation and smile makeovers.

In 2013 the American Board of Prosthodontics awarded him Diplomate status, the most prestigious credential in the field. He holds hospital privileges at Inova Fairfax, the only Level 1 trauma hospital in Northern Virginia.

He has published in national and international scientific journals, lectures on smile design and dental implants, and teaches hands-on courses for other dentists — the kind of work that tends to bring the difficult cases to his door.

Credentials & Certifications

  • Diplomate, American Board of Prosthodontics
  • Certificate in Prosthodontics
  • M.S., Master of Science in Oral Biology
  • Hospital Privileges, Inova Fairfax Hospital
  • Fellow, International Congress of Oral Implantologists
  • Associate Fellow, American Academy of Implant Dentistry
  • IV Sedation Certificate
  • BLS & ACLS Provider

chunks.label: path
chunks.html:
Chapter 05 · The Path

Four visits, not four years.

01

Consultation & 3D Scan

A cone-beam scan shows the bone we actually have to work with. You leave knowing whether you are a candidate, what it costs, and how long it takes.

02

Digital Smile Design

The final teeth are designed before a single implant is placed. You approve the result in advance rather than hoping for it.

03

Guided Placement

Implants are placed through a surgical guide built from your scan, under sedation if you want it. Many patients leave the same day with fixed teeth.

04

Final Restoration

Once healing is complete the definitive teeth go in — shaped, shaded and bite-balanced by the same specialist who planned them.

chunks.label: standard
chunks.html:
Chapter 06 · The Standard

Everything under one roof.

Planning, surgery, sedation and the lab that makes your teeth — all in the same building, run by the same team. That is what removes the handoffs.

In-House Laboratory
Your teeth are made here. An on-site lab means shade, shape and fit are adjusted in minutes rather than posted to a third party and waited on for weeks.
3D Imaging
Planned in three dimensions. Cone-beam scans map bone before anything is placed.
IV Sedation
Through it in one sitting. IV-sedation certified, so long appointments pass in what feels like minutes.
The Practice
Built for long visits. Two Northern Virginia offices designed around full-day treatment.
